item_short_desc: Nite-Ize S-Biners are the perfect solution for securely attaching and connecting your keys, gear, or valuables. Constructed from high-quality stainless steel, these double-gated carabiners offer unmatched durability and versatility. The innovative double-gated design allows you to clip items on one side while attaching the other side to belts, backpacks, pockets, or other anchor points. Available in various sizes, the S-Biners can hold different weights to suit your needs.
description: Nite-Ize S-Biners are the perfect solution for securely attaching and connecting your keys, gear, or valuables. Constructed from high-quality stainless steel, these double-gated carabiners offer unmatched durability and versatility. The innovative double-gated design allows you to clip items on one side while attaching the other side to belts, backpacks, pockets, or other anchor points. Available in various sizes, the S-Biners can hold different weights to suit your needs. The #2 size has a load limit of 10lbs and measures 2 inches x 7/8 inch, the #3 size has a load limit of 25lbs and measures 2 5/8 inches x 1 1/8 inches, and the #4 size has a load limit of 75lbs and measures 3 1/2 inches x 1 1/2 inches. Whether for everyday use or outdoor adventures, these multipurpose S-Biners are designed to provide reliable and convenient solutions for organizing and securing your belongings. Lightweight yet strong, they are ideal for a wide range of applications, making them a must-have accessory for anyone on the go.
